more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Potassium bromate is used as a raising agent in food. Its technological role is to release gas that increases the volume of dough.
more_info.daily_intake: JECFA judged use as a flour-treatment agent unacceptable (1992, reaffirmed 1995); no current food-use ADI was established.
more_info.side_effects:
JECFA reaffirmed its concern about bromate residues remaining in bread in 1995.
That evaluation did not establish an acceptable flour-treatment exposure.
